newsitem.title: UK: UK grain markets quiet and little changed.
newsitem.headline: UK grain markets quiet and little changed.

text.p: UK cash and futures grains market were quiet and little changed on Thursday.
"There is no interest at all in the market," said one broker.
In the cash sector fob prices were unchanged with no business reported while delivered material was trading 0.50 stg down on a thin market.
LIFFE wheat futures were little better with old crop 0.75 stg down and new crop unchanged on a light turnover of 180 lots.
Barley futures were unchanged after trading seven lots.
